title: 3 Ways to Make Python Code 10x Faster

beats.hook: Your Python is slow for 1 reason
beats.voice: Your Python code isn't slow because of the language. It's slow because of how you loop.

beats.label: speedup with list comprehensions
beats.voice: Replacing manual appends with list comprehensions gives an instant twelve times speedup.

beats.caption: Three Quick Fixes|Use built-in functions|Vectorize with Numpy|Avoid global lookups
beats.voice: Use built-in functions, vectorize your math with NumPy, and avoid global lookups inside tight loops.
Always optimize your algorithm before blaming the language.
